candidate.title: DeepSeek-R1 Explained by Google Engineer | Reinforcement Learning | LLM Training Paradigm Shift
candidate.description:
As a normal regular SWE, I want to share my insights into DeepSeek’s best model R1, how it changed the LLM training paradigm, and why it’s great for reinformencement learnings. After this video, you should be familiar with DeepSeek R1’s training process, and more importantly, why they reached that process.
